posts.caption:
The loudest tone in this scream is not played by the synth.

Operator makes a saw plus a feedback sine 13 times higher, through a band-pass at 9 kHz with 88 % resonance. With Redux off, I measured the energy at 5.9 and 7.6 kHz. Redux resamples at 8.14 kHz, so everything above 4.07 kHz folds back down: 8.14 - 5.9 = 2.2 kHz. With Redux on, 2.2 kHz is the loudest peak. Aliasing, used on purpose.

The bit depth is automated too: the first three screams get 7, 11 and 15 bits.

From Uhrwerk aus Blut, out now. Part 8 next: the gothic layer.
